feeds.title: Oil Painters Of America Blog
feeds.description: Oil Painters of America exists to fuel the appreciation & preservation of representational art. Distinguished artists from across North America share wisdom & perspectives to encourage and further the mission of the organization.

feeds.title: Mikki Senkarik
feeds.description: Mikki Senkarik an Oil paint artist from Texas. Painting and sketching are the breath of life for me and I can't imagine living without being able to produce artwork.

feeds.title: Ryan Studio
feeds.description: Oil paintings by Abbey Ryan. He makes 'A Painting a Day'. His paintings have been featured in O, The Oprah Magazine's 'Live Your Best Life Women Who Make Beautiful Things,' Seth Godin's bestseller, Linchpin: Are You Indispensible?, and FOX's Good Day Philadelphia.

feeds.title: David Tanner Blog
feeds.description: David Tanner is a representational oil painter in Richmond, Virginia. David teaches oil painting at the Visual Arts Center of Richmond, where he was elected Master Teacher in 2006.

feeds.title: Charlene Marsh Studio and Gallery Blog
feeds.description: Charlene Marsh an oil painter who loves to hike into remote areas off the beaten path to paint on location in all four seasons. And, yes, also love to paint even in the cold, snowy winter. Some of her favorite, most beautiful paintings are done in the winter. She also love to paint spring bursting forth, summer flowers, and the colors of autumn.

feeds.title: Barbara Haviland Blog
feeds.description: Barbara is a self taught contemporary, raw artist who paints Landscape Oil Paintings and draws inspiration from the world around me.

feeds.title: Bronwyn Ford's Original Oil Paintings
feeds.description: Bronwyn Ford's an Oil painter from New Hampshire love to paint flowers, pets, landscapes etc.

feeds.title: Debra Hurd Original Paintings AND Jazz Art
feeds.description: Debra Hurd an Oil painter, is famous for her insightful paintings of animals, her vivid city scenes and her passionate and perceptive depictions of jazz, rock, and blues musicians.

feeds.title: Oil Paintings by Nina R. Aide
feeds.description: Nina R. Aide a painter of still life and landscapes. Most of her work is painted in oils in chiaroscuro and traditional classic style, still life and landscape, kitchen art paintings, fruit and more

feeds.title: Artist's Network
feeds.description: Easy-to-follow, step-by-step tutorials on how to paint with with oil, covering a variety of topics including classical underpaintings, glazing, surface treatments and building up the paint for texture from Artist's Network.

feeds.title: Master Oil Painting Blog
feeds.description: Oil painting sales, commissions, techniques & free art instruction videos from an award winning artist Bill Inman who shares with you the secrets to become a professional artist. Bill's work can be found in collections from Switzerland to Saudi Arabia and throughout the United States and Canada.

feeds.title: Simon's Blog
feeds.description: Pet portraits, portrait commissions, landscapes and other original paintings in oil by Seattle based artist Simon Bland.

feeds.title: Roy Connelly Blog
feeds.description: Roy work exclusively in oils, painting from life by the direct observation of my subject. He paint outside throughout the year and in all weathers - the delicate quality of light in the winter months is his favourite subject. He have Exhibited at Royal Academy Summer Exhibition, New English Art Club (NEAC) and Royal Institute of Oil Painters (ROI).

feeds.title: Nancy Romanovsky Blog
feeds.description: Representational landscape painter specializing in aspen trees and forests. Her chosen medium is oil, with variety of brushwork, thick and thin, loose and detailed. It gives her the opportunity to portray the breadth and scale of nature.

feeds.title: Jonelle Summerfield Oil Paintings
feeds.description: Jonelle Summerfield an oil painter from Western Pennsylvania who paints subjects include interiors, animals, still life and scenes from her travels.

feeds.title: Sonia Kane Blog
feeds.description: North Carolina artist Sonia Kane is a painter of sunlit moments. The 'oh wow' moments are the inspiration for her oil paintings as they remind her to linger and savor God's world.

feeds.title: Bradley Goff Blog
feeds.description: Bradley Goff an Oil Painting Artist from Kalamazoo Michigan whose oil paintings are influenced by texture and color.

feeds.title: Norma's Daily Paintings Blog
feeds.description: Professional Artist who paints everday. Animal, florals, still life subjects, custom pet portraits.

feeds.title: Twiggs Original Oil Paintings
feeds.description: Lori Twiggs paints dramatic still life with a focus on light and shadow that gives my paintings a sense of quiet drama. She paints exclusively in oils on canvas or board.

feeds.title: Cathleen Rehfeld
feeds.description: Cathleen Rehfeld an oil painter love doing small daily oil paintings. They have an immediate freshness about them. Whatever you are thinking about that day goes into them, almost like a visual diary. She love the creamy color and intense luscious look of oil paint, making brushstrokes that bring out that quality in the paint and try new ideas, colors, and subject matter.

feeds.title: Bill Hibbard Blog
feeds.description: Bill an oil painter, portraiture, landscape painter, workshop teacher, illustrator, artist working in oils primarily.

feeds.title: Alan Reed Art
feeds.description: Alan Reed's Painting Blog with tips and demonstrations how to paint with Oil paints.

feeds.title: Jackson's Art Blog
feeds.description: Posts by Julie, Christine & Duncan on Oil painting techniques from Jackson's Art.

feeds.title: Brent Jensen Oil Painter
feeds.description: Brent Jensen, Impressionist plein air and studio oil painter. Known for seascape maritime scenes, landscapes, architectural compositions and European locations.

feeds.title: Jacqueline Chanda Blog
feeds.description: A website of oil paintings and artwork for art lovers by Jacqueline Chanda. Who combine drawing with oil painting by using both the knife and the paintbrush and like the effortless movement, looseness and luminescent quality that oils allow.
